═══ SESSION cont: 26 CLOSED · FIVE AGENTS IN PARALLEL · CI CAUGHT AN UNCOMMITTED-EDIT ERROR I MADE ·
A DEBUG AGENT DISPROVED MY OWN BUG FILING ═══

## STATE: 26 closed / 5 in_progress / 7 open, of 38 descendants
CLOSED THIS SESSION: 5e75, 7a79, d5c7.
Operator decision: ALL descendants close under 061c — nothing is re-parented OUT. Two bugs filed this
session were parented IN (f81d, 635f), and the df2c agent added child 12e4, so 35 -> 38.

## THE MISTAKE WORTH CARRYING FORWARD: local green on a tree the commit did not contain
Gerrit 1230 took Verified -1. NOT a flake, NOT CANCELLED, NOT a coverage-gap infra -1: the default
suite failed identically on ubuntu-py3.11/3.12/3.13 and macos-py3.13, 3 failed / 8858 passed.
THE TELL was the failing test NAME — `..._foreign_family_is_unchanged`, a name I had RENAMED to
`..._is_explicit`. CI was running a file that lacked the rename.
  git status  ->  M tests/unit/test_model_class_ladder.py
  git show HEAD:<file> | grep -c _is_explicit  ->  0        grep -c in worktree  ->  1
The three assertion fixes were edited into the WORKING TREE after the cherry-pick and never folded in.
The later 77ed cherry-pick did not object because it touches a different file.
EVERY local run I cited — 8908 passed, the mutation check, the 8909 stacked run — executed the working
tree. The pushed commits did not contain the edits. THE GUARD IS MECHANICAL, NOT ATTENTIONAL:
assert `git status --porcelain` is EMPTY before running the suite you intend to cite, and again before
pushing, and RECORD the dirty-line count in the same file as the gate exit codes so the evidence
cannot be separated from the tree it measured. The re-verification does exactly that
(`tree-dirty-lines=0`).
FIX: stash -> reset to the 48b3 commit -> restore -> `commit --amend --no-edit` (4 files, was 3) ->
re-cherry-pick 77ed. Both Change-Ids preserved, so the re-push UPDATES 1229/1230.

## A DEBUG AGENT DISPROVED MY FILING OF 635f — the correction is the valuable part
I filed 635f claiming an errored pair is retained BECAUSE `dropped` is in `_DECISIONS`, and left a
"may be only latent, reclassify if the decision resolves outside _DECISIONS" escape hatch. BOTH WRONG.
  * `parity.py:105` is `if a.label in _DECISIONS` — it filters on the GOLD LABEL, never on `decision`.
    `_DECISIONS` does double duty as decision vocabulary AND label vocabulary, which is what makes the
    line read as though it filters on decision.
  * DISCRIMINATING EXPERIMENT: errored side given `decision="__error__"` (outside `_DECISIONS`) was
    still RETAINED and counted — flips=1, passed=False. So NO value of `decision` exempts an errored
    pair, and changing `fidelity_spot_eval.py:174` would be a NO-OP.
  * The flip line is `:107`; `:106` is `n_gold`. My citation was off by one.
  * WORSE VARIANT FOUND: `errored=True, valid=True` yields flips=1, validity_v2=1.0 — a COMPLETELY
    SILENT fabricated flip. The only reason the normal case is noticeable is that
    `fidelity_spot_eval.py:174` happens to couple errored with valid=False; nothing enforces it.
  * The report cannot distinguish fabrications: arms with 3 real / 2 real+1 error / 0 real+3 errors all
    emit a BYTE-IDENTICAL gating string. `error_rate` is per-arm, never per-pair.
  * `parity.py:46` documents `errored` as "a runtime error / timeout (NOT a model verdict)", and
    criterion (d) already gates error rate — so scoring it under (b) violates the module's own contract
    and double-counts one event.
All verified against source before accepting. 635f's description was REWRITTEN with the proven
mechanism and both dead ends named explicitly, because as filed it would have sent an implementer to a
no-op fix.

## PARALLEL AGENTS — what worked and the constraint that shaped it
next-batch's conflict matrix was VACUOUS: 1157/5267/df2c had NO declared file_impact, so all-dots meant
"nothing to compare", not "proven disjoint". Every agent was therefore told to DECLARE file_impact
FIRST and abort on collision with a named reserved list. 1157 was held back entirely — it touches
sizing.py, which 48b3 owns unpushed.
  df2c   DONE  commit 7065736f4b, plan review PASS, suite exit 0 (8964 passed), mutation both
               directions (7 failed reverted -> 75 passed restored). Filed child 12e4 for AC5.
               It independently hit the `make lint | grep` trap: ruff check printed "All checks
               passed!" while ruff format --check failed in the SAME run.
  0d76   plan remediated to PASS on the FIRST review, zero rounds. The agent correctly REFUSED to apply
         an already-drafted remediation once it passed, because a material edit would invalidate the
         fresh attestation for no gain. Implementation agent then STALLED (watchdog, 600s) with two
         UNTRACKED files on disk; resumed from transcript with checkpoint-first instructions.
  5267 / 8415 / f81d-debug still running at handoff.

## OPERATIONAL FACTS EARNED THIS SESSION
* A shared-hooks hazard: installing the Gerrit commit-msg hook OVERWRITES the pre-commit-managed one in
  the SHARED .git/hooks (worktrees share it). Correct state is migration mode — `commit-msg` (pre-commit
  wrapper) PLUS `commit-msg.legacy` (the Gerrit Change-Id stamper). `make hooks` restores it. VERIFIED
  present after the df2c agent's `make hooks`; without the .legacy file every Gerrit push loses its
  Change-Id.
* `rebar review-plan` has NO `--json` flag — it is `-o json`.
* A close can fail on the store lock AFTER its verifier has already run and been paid for
  (7a79, CLOSE_EXIT=1, sidecar emit failed, ticket stayed in_progress). Retry loops that RE-READ state
  each pass and stop on observed success are the only reliable pattern; a shell echo proves nothing.
* Foreground tool calls are capped at 10 minutes. review-plan (~6 min), closes, and full suites (~21 min)
  must run in the BACKGROUND or they are killed mid-flight. A killed review-plan still leaves valid
  usage-log rows.
* Gerrit changes owned by RebarBotNava are NOT necessarily this session's — every session shares the
  identity. Check the `rebar-ticket:` trailer against the epic's descendant list before submitting.
  Change 1228 (0347) was green and submittable and was correctly LEFT ALONE.
